name: Starlight Carousel of Crystal Horses
description: An antique carousel floating in space, its horses carved from clear crystal that refract distant galaxies.
prompt: A vintage carousel rotating slowly in the vacuum of space. Each horse is sculpted from flawless crystal, capturing and refracting surrounding nebulae and star clusters. The platform is a disc of dark obsidian. Soft cosmic lighting, particles of stardust drifting. Hyper‑realistic, cinematic, sense of weightlessness.
caption: Ride the constellations 🎠🌠 #CrystalCarousel
